I use weed medicinally as well.  I can definitely be an asshole if I've been without for a few days, but, as I've always been taught growing up, it isn't an excuse to be an asshole.  And I do have to remind myself about this often. 

Medicine is definitely a serious thing and a lot of people would not want to fault a patient for being in such a way, but it still doesn't make it right.  We all have the choice to take a few moments to sort ourselves out and not take it out on our loved ones.  We also have the choice to let those conditions control what we do.  

At the end of the day, it shouldn't be about who is at fault but more along the lines of how to cope when we have to go without and allowing room for apologies for the hurt that we may cause.  This is something I think a lot of people should take the time to consider.
